name: On-message content check
description: Check drafts (blog posts, ads, emails, social) against your messaging before they ship. Replace the bracketed pillar text with your own.

messaging_fit.instructions: How clearly does this content express our core message: [replace with your one-sentence positioning]?
criteria: Expresses it clearly in at least one place
Built around it from start to finish

primary_pillar.instructions: Which messaging pillar does this content mainly support?

unsupported_claim.instructions: The content states a number, ranking or superlative (fastest, best, #1, only) without naming a source.
